method.headline: Illustrative tailpipe running-exhaust scenario, not a measured inventory.
method.traffic: SUMO 1.28 random origin–destination runs shape road speed and relative pressure. Routes are assumed, not observed.
method.volume: Latest matched weekday LADOT 2011–2016 directional count anchors; other streets use stated functional-class daily-volume assumptions. Midday 6% and PM peak 8.5% of daily traffic.
method.emissions: SUMO edge-level running-emissions variation normalized to 2026 Los Angeles EMFAC2025 v2.1.1 fleet VMT-weighted running-exhaust CO₂ and NOₓ rates. Excludes non-tailpipe and upstream emissions.
method.uncertainty: Illustrative sensitivity: approximately ±35% at historical anchors and ±60% on assumed-volume roads; these are judgmental ranges, not confidence intervals.
method.signal: OSM signal locations and SUMO generated timing; actual signal plans were unavailable.
